name: update_state_flags_and_counter
description: Writes a series of status bytes chosen by the current flag value, and when that flag is set it subtracts 100 from a 16-bit counter before calling a routine several times in sequence. The code shows the branching clearly but not the game-level meaning of the flags.

name: stage_marker_49_and_call
description: Writes the value 49 into a status byte, invokes a routine, then writes 1 back into that byte. It is a short set-call-reset sequence with no other logic.

name: set_status_113_and_call
description: Stores the value 113 into a status byte, invokes a routine and returns. Nothing else happens in the routine.

name: stage_marker_49_and_return
description: Stores the value 49 into a status byte, invokes a routine and returns. It repeats the store-and-call pattern of its neighbouring routines without a reset step.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: relay_routine_call_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns without any other action. It is identical in effect to its neighbouring pass-through routine.

name: dispatch_on_flag_then_call
description: Branches on a flag byte, clearing status bytes and calling routines in each branch, then writes a table pointer value and makes two further calls. The two branches differ only in where the status byte is cleared.

name: dispatch_state_codes_with_calls
description: Compares a state byte against several values and, for each matching case, writes one of two codes into it and calls routines, with and without an extra clear step. Two parallel branch blocks run in sequence, and the code shows the branches but not the overall purpose.

name: check_range_and_set_flag
description: Saves a status byte, clears it, and compares one of two stored 16-bit values against the thresholds 194 and 14, choosing which one by a flag byte. It sets a status byte to 1 and restores the saved value only when the check passes, and returns early otherwise.

name: check_pair_thresholds_with_compare
description: Clears a status byte and compares two stored 16-bit values against the thresholds 14 and 194, with the branch chosen by a flag byte. It calls a routine to compare a byte at an offset from a pointer, and sets a status byte to 1 when the comparison passes.

name: offset_paired_values_when_high
description: When a counter byte is above 9, it sets a value to 22, clears the byte, and adds 80 to one 16-bit value while subtracting 20 from another. A second identical block then does the same with the two values swapped.

name: clear_four_words_and_step
description: Calls a long run of routines, and when a control byte is nonzero it clears four 16-bit values and returns. Otherwise it runs a dispatch over several state codes, calling routines between branches, before clearing the same four values again.

name: clear_word_value
description: Writes zero into a single 16-bit value and returns. The block contains no other logic.

name: snapshot_state_and_restore
description: Copies several 16-bit values and status bytes into locals on entry, then runs a sequence of counter updates and conditional routine calls. It writes the saved values back on exit, and an early branch takes the same restore path.

name: restore_state_from_parameters
description: Runs the same counter and dispatch sequence as its sibling routine, then writes state back from its parameter list on exit. It returns the last parameter.

name: set_marker_and_restore_params
description: Writes 97 and 0 into a pair of status words, calls a routine, then writes the parameter values back to their stored locations. It returns the last parameter.

name: reset_flags_and_restore_params
description: Sets two status bytes to 1 and clears two status words, conditionally calls routines in two branches, then writes the parameter values back to their stored locations. It returns the last parameter.

name: run_state_machine_then_restore
description: Runs a state-byte dispatch with tangled branches and a series of routine calls, then writes the parameter values back to their stored locations. It returns the last parameter.

name: advance_state_machine_by_mode
description: Returns early when a control byte is set, otherwise copies two stored values and selects one of several branches from a mode byte. Each branch sets a timer-like value and a transition code, then calls routines.

name: reset_then_advance_state_machine
description: Clears a control byte first and then performs the same mode-dependent state selection as its sibling routine, copying two stored values and choosing a transition code. The pair differ only in that initial clear.

name: select_transition_from_mode_byte
description: Returns early when a control byte is set, otherwise saves two stored values and dispatches on a mode byte to one of four groups. Each group writes a transition code and a counter value, calls routines, and may step the transition code to a neighbouring value.

name: select_transition_when_active
description: Returns early when a control byte is clear, then performs the same mode-based dispatch and transition-code selection as its sibling routine. It does not repeat the first early-return test of that sibling.

name: select_transition_unconditional
description: Runs the mode-based dispatch and transition-code selection with no initial guard, copying two stored values first. It is the unguarded form of its sibling routines.

name: set_counter_by_mode_code
description: When a mode byte equals 2 it calls two routines, writes 2 into a counter byte and returns. Otherwise it calls two routines, writes 4 into the same counter byte and returns.

name: call_two_then_set_four
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then writes the value 4 into a counter byte and returns. It has no branches.

name: dispatch_transition_by_counter
description: Calls a routine, then dispatches on a counter byte and a transition code to choose between several branches, writing new transition codes and calling routines in each. The branch structure is clear but the overall purpose is not shown.

name: cycle_codes_four_and_five
description: Writes 11 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 4 and 5, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_4_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 4, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_5_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 5, calls a routine and returns.

name: cycle_codes_six_and_seven
description: Writes 10 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 6 and 7, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_6_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 6, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_7_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 7, calls a routine and returns.

name: cycle_codes_zero_and_one
description: Writes 8 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 0 and 1, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_0_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 0, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_1_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 1, calls a routine and returns.

name: cycle_codes_two_and_three
description: Writes 9 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 2 and 3, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_2_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 2, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_3_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 3, calls a routine and returns.

name: map_code_to_group_target
description: Maps the current transition code to a group target: 0, 1 and 8 become 8, 2, 3 and 9 become 9, 4, 5 and 11 become 11, and 6, 7 and 10 become 10. Codes outside these sets leave it unchanged, and each mapping then calls a routine.

name: set_code_8_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 8, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_9_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 9, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_11_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 11, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_10_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 10, calls a routine and returns.

name: update_countdown_and_scale_offset
description: Decrements a countdown byte and reloads it from a saved value when it reaches zero, otherwise it copies a saved transition code. It copies saved values when a flag is set, then stores a 16-bit value multiplied by the transition code plus a base constant that depends on a mode byte.

name: reload_countdown_and_scale_offset
description: Reloads the countdown byte from its saved value, copies saved values when a flag is set, and stores a 16-bit value multiplied by the transition code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte. It is the same as its sibling without the countdown step.

name: scale_offset_from_code
description: Calls routines, copies saved values when a flag is set, and stores a 16-bit value multiplied by the transition code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte. It has no countdown handling.

name: scale_offset_from_saved_code
description: Copies a saved transition code when a flag condition holds, then stores a 16-bit value multiplied by that code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte. It is the tail of its larger siblings.

name: check_table_entry_then_advance
description: Looks up a table entry by a state byte and, if its value is nonzero and within a range of a stored position, sets a status byte and returns. Otherwise it increments a counter and clamps it at 56, and the branch uses a threshold of 194 for one stored value.

name: check_entry_and_advance_counter
description: Looks up a table entry by a state byte and sets a status byte when the entry is nonzero and within range of a stored position. Otherwise it increments a counter and clamps it at 56.

name: increment_counter_clamped_at_56
description: Adds 1 to a counter and clamps it at 56 when it exceeds that value. It also sets a status byte at that point.

name: check_table_then_decrement_counter
description: Checks a table entry and a threshold of 194 for one stored value, setting a status byte and returning when the check passes. Otherwise it decrements a counter and clamps it at a minimum of 35.

name: check_entry_and_decrement_counter
description: Checks a table entry against a stored position and sets a status byte when it passes. Otherwise it decrements a counter and clamps it at a minimum of 35.

name: decrement_counter_clamped_at_35
description: Subtracts 1 from a counter and clamps it at a minimum of 35, setting a status byte when the clamp applies.

name: step_value_down_with_checks
description: Calls a routine and tests a table entry and a flag bit. When the test fails or the routine returns a value above 3, it lowers a 16-bit value by 2 with a floor of 15, otherwise it lowers it by 2 with a floor of 1 and sets a status byte.

name: decrement_value_by_two_floor
description: Subtracts 2 from a 16-bit value and sets it to 1 when it would drop below that floor, setting a status byte at the same time.

name: increase_value_by_two_capped
description: Adds 2 to a 16-bit value and caps it at 193 or 211 depending on a table entry, a flag bit and a routine result. Its other branch adds 2 and caps the value at 211 after a table check.

name: raise_value_to_limit
description: Adds 2 to a 16-bit value and clamps it at 211 when the result exceeds 210, setting a status byte at the same time.

name: stub_return_no_operation
description: Contains only a return and no other instruction. It is an empty stub.

name: retry_compare_three_times
description: Clears a status byte, then retries a comparison up to three times, calling routines and checking two 16-bit values read through pointers. It sets the status byte to 1 when a comparison passes and returns with it clear if every attempt fails.

name: poll_comparison_until_count_ends
description: Repeatedly calls a routine while a table value and two pointer-read 16-bit comparisons do not pass, counting down each pass. It sets a status byte to 1 when the comparison passes and returns when the count runs out.

name: retry_compare_three_times
description: Clears a status byte, then retries a comparison up to three times, calling routines and checking two 16-bit values read through pointers. It sets the status byte to 1 when a comparison passes and returns with it clear if every attempt fails. The code is identical to its sibling at the earlier address.

name: poll_comparison_until_count_ends
description: Repeatedly calls a routine while a table value and two pointer-read 16-bit comparisons do not pass, counting down each pass. It sets a status byte to 1 when the comparison passes and returns when the count runs out. The code is identical to its sibling at the earlier address.

name: check_two_values_below_limits
description: Clears a status byte, then if a 16-bit value is below 18 it reads a second value and sets the status byte to 1 when that is below 2.

name: check_limits_then_add_four
description: Clears a status byte, then if a 16-bit value is below 18 it reads a second value and, when that is below 2, sets the status byte to 1 and adds 4 to it.

name: advance_second_machine_by_mode
description: Returns early when a control byte is set, otherwise copies two stored values and dispatches on a mode byte to one of four groups of transition codes between 12 and 23. Each group writes a counter value, steps its code within a pair and calls routines, and with a zero mode the code is mapped to a group target.

name: reset_then_advance_second_machine
description: Clears a control byte first and then performs the same mode-dependent dispatch and transition-code selection as its sibling routine, copying two stored values. The pair differ only in that initial clear.

name: select_second_transition_guarded
description: Returns early when a control byte is set or clear in a way that leaves it inactive, then performs the second group mode dispatch and transition-code selection. It copies two stored values before dispatching.

name: select_second_transition_when_active
description: Returns early when a control byte is clear, then performs the second group mode dispatch and transition-code selection, copying two stored values first.

name: select_second_transition_unconditional
description: Runs the second group mode dispatch and transition-code selection with no initial guard, copying two stored values first. It is the unguarded form of its sibling routines.

name: set_second_counter_by_mode
description: When a mode byte equals 2 it calls two routines, writes 2 into a second counter byte and returns. Otherwise it calls two routines, writes 4 into that byte and returns.

name: call_pair_set_second_four
description: Calls two routines in sequence, then writes the value 4 into a second counter byte and returns. It has no branches.

name: dispatch_second_transition_by_counter
description: Calls a routine, then dispatches on a counter byte and a transition code to choose between several branches, writing new transition codes and calling routines in each. It is the second group's counterpart to its earlier sibling routine.

name: cycle_codes_sixteen_and_seventeen
description: Writes 23 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 16 and 17, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_16_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 16, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_17_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 17, calls a routine and returns.

name: cycle_codes_eighteen_and_nineteen
description: Writes 22 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 18 and 19, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_18_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 18, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_19_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 19, calls a routine and returns.

name: cycle_codes_twelve_and_thirteen
description: Writes 20 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 12 and 13, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_12_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 12, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_13_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 13, calls a routine and returns.

name: cycle_codes_fourteen_and_fifteen
description: Writes 21 into a second field, then alternates the transition code between 14 and 15, calling a routine after each change.

name: set_code_14_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 14, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_15_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 15, calls a routine and returns.

name: map_wide_code_target
description: Maps the current transition code to a group target: 12, 13 and 20 become 20, 14, 15 and 21 become 21, 16, 17 and 23 become 23, and 18, 19 and 22 become 22. Any other code leaves it unchanged, and each mapping then calls a routine.

name: set_code_20_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 20, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_21_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 21, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_23_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 23, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_code_22_and_call
description: Writes the transition code 22, calls a routine and returns.

name: update_second_countdown_and_scale
description: Decrements a second countdown byte and reloads it from a saved value when it reaches zero, otherwise it copies a saved transition code. It copies saved values when a flag is set, then stores a 16-bit value multiplied by the transition code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte.

name: reload_second_countdown_and_scale
description: Reloads the second countdown byte from its saved value, copies saved values when a flag is set, and stores a 16-bit value multiplied by the transition code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte. It is the same as its sibling without the countdown step.

name: scale_second_offset_from_code
description: Calls routines, copies saved values when a flag is set, and stores a 16-bit value multiplied by the transition code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte. It has no countdown handling.

name: scale_second_saved_offset
description: Copies a saved transition code when a flag condition holds, then stores a 16-bit value multiplied by that code plus a base constant chosen by a mode byte. It is the tail of its larger siblings.

name: check_second_table_then_advance
description: Looks up a table entry by a state byte and, if its value is nonzero and within range of a stored position plus 156, sets a status byte and returns. Otherwise it increments a second counter and clamps it at 156, using a threshold of 194 for one stored value.

name: check_second_entry_then_advance
description: Looks up a table entry by a state byte and sets a status byte when the entry is nonzero and within range of a stored position plus 156. Otherwise it increments a second counter and clamps it at 156.

name: increment_second_counter_clamped
description: Adds 1 to a second counter and clamps it at 156 when it exceeds 155, setting a status byte at the same time.

name: check_second_table_then_decrement
description: Checks a table entry and a stored position plus 156 against a threshold, setting a status byte and returning when the check passes. Otherwise it decrements a second counter and clamps it at a minimum of 135.

name: check_second_entry_then_decrement
description: Checks a table entry against a stored position plus 156 and sets a status byte when it passes. Otherwise it decrements a second counter and clamps it at a minimum of 135.

name: decrement_second_counter_clamped
description: Subtracts 1 from a second counter and clamps it at a minimum of 135, setting a status byte when the clamp applies.

name: step_second_value_checked
description: Calls a routine and tests a table entry and a flag bit. When the test fails or the routine returns a value above 3, it lowers a second 16-bit value by 2 with a floor of 15, otherwise it lowers it by 2 with a floor of 1 and sets a status byte.

name: decrement_second_value_floor
description: Subtracts 2 from a second 16-bit value and sets it to 1 when it would drop below that floor, setting a status byte at the same time.

name: increase_second_value_capped
description: Adds 2 to a second 16-bit value and caps it at 193 or 211 depending on a table entry, a flag bit and a routine result. Its other branch adds 2 and caps the value at 211 after a table check.

name: raise_second_value_to_limit
description: Adds 2 to a second 16-bit value and clamps it at 211 when the result exceeds 210, setting a status byte at the same time.

name: stub_return_no_operation
description: Contains only a return and no other instruction. It is an empty stub identical to its earlier sibling.

name: store_sixteen_and_call
description: Writes the value 16 into one of a group of stored fields, calls a routine and returns.

name: store_twenty_one_and_call
description: Writes the value 21 into one of a group of stored fields, calls a routine and returns.

name: store_flagged_value_first
description: Writes 5 into a stored field, then writes 36 into it instead when a status byte equals 1, and returns.

name: store_flagged_value_second
description: Writes 5 into a second stored field, then writes 36 into it instead when a status byte equals 1, and returns. It is the same as its sibling for a different field.

name: initialise_state_block_defaults
description: Writes a long list of default constants into status bytes, 16-bit fields and counters, then clears the remaining flags. It runs once as a set of straight-line stores and returns after the full list.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routines one after the other and returns. It has no branches or stored values.

name: switch_long_constant_and_call
description: Calls a routine, sets a 32-bit value to one constant, calls two routines, then sets it to a second constant and calls a routine. It sequences two constants through the same set of calls.

name: sequence_long_constants_copy
description: Runs the same constant-switching call sequence as its sibling, with one 32-bit value set to two constants around a set of routine calls. It is identical in effect to its neighbour.

name: sequence_constants_unless_flagged
description: When a status byte is not 1, it sets a 32-bit value to one constant, calls two routines, sets it to a second constant and calls a routine. It returns without doing anything when the status byte is 1.

name: call_sequence_when_inactive
description: Returns at once when a status byte is 1, otherwise it sets a 32-bit value to a constant and calls two routines before returning. The loop it contains never repeats.

name: call_sequence_when_inactive
description: Behaves the same as its identical sibling: it returns when a status byte is 1, otherwise it sets a 32-bit value to a constant and calls two routines before returning.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: sequence_constants_unless_flagged
description: Behaves the same as its identical sibling: when a status byte is not 1, it sets a 32-bit value to one constant, calls two routines, sets it to a second constant and calls a routine.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: clear_flag_and_set_counters
description: Clears a status byte, writes 39 into one counter and 2 into another, then calls a routine and returns.

name: set_two_counters_and_call
description: Writes 39 into one counter and 2 into another, calls a routine and returns. It is the same as its sibling without the status byte clear.

name: clear_flag_and_set_counters
description: Clears a status byte, writes 39 into one counter and 2 into another, then calls a routine and returns. It is identical to its sibling routine.

name: set_two_counters_and_call
description: Writes 39 into one counter and 2 into another, calls a routine and returns. It is the same as its neighbouring routine without the status byte clear.

name: set_two_counters_and_call
description: Writes 39 into one counter and 2 into another, calls a routine and returns. It is identical to its sibling routines.

name: set_two_counters_and_call
description: Writes 39 into one counter and 2 into another, calls a routine and returns. It is identical to its sibling routines.

name: write_counter_pair_sequence
description: Writes a fixed table of 19 pairs of values into two counter fields in order, calling a routine after each pair. The pairs are constant and the routine ends after the last one.

name: set_long_first_and_call
description: Writes a fixed 32-bit constant into a long value, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_long_second_and_call
description: Writes a different fixed 32-bit constant into the same long value, calls a routine and returns.

name: copy_records_and_call_routine
description: Loops over a block of records, three words at a time, copying each record into two stored words and a third word from a counter field. It calls a routine for each record and stops when the record count reaches zero.

name: compute_scaled_value_and_call
description: Stores a 32-bit value equal to an input 16-bit value multiplied by a stored value plus an input base, then calls a routine and returns.

name: walk_byte_pair_table
description: Walks a table of byte pairs in nested loops. For each entry it looks up two values from a second table scaled by eight, masks status bytes with 248, and calls routines to write the results and a computed offset, repeating until the outer count wraps.

name: copy_words_to_second_set
description: Copies three working 16-bit values into a second set of stored fields. The guarding comparison is always true in this form, so the copy always runs.

name: copy_words_to_alternate_set
description: Copies the same three working 16-bit values into an alternate set of stored fields. The guarding comparison is always true in this form, so the copy always runs.

name: adjust_value_minus_70_call
description: When a status byte is nonzero, subtracts 70 from a 16-bit value, clears a word, sets a status byte to 1 and calls two routines. It returns without action otherwise.

name: adjust_value_set_mode_two
description: When a status byte is nonzero, subtracts 70 from a 16-bit value, sets a word to 97 and a status byte to 2, then calls two routines. It returns without action otherwise.

name: set_word_97_clear_flag
description: Writes 97 into a 16-bit word and clears a status byte, then returns.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: clear_word_and_flag
description: Clears a 16-bit word and a status byte, then returns.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: fill_plane_rows_pattern
description: Loops 65 times over a four-plane screen buffer whose planes are 4000 words apart, advancing 20 words per pass. Each pass writes all-ones words into the first rows of the planes and zeros into the others.

name: reset_countdown_to_fifty
description: Decrements a byte counter and returns while it is not zero. When it reaches zero it reloads the counter with 50 and decrements it twice more.

name: select_case_by_stored_code
description: Returns at once when a status byte is set. Otherwise it selects a case from a stored code of 0, 1, 2, 4 or 8, updates a related code, calls routines in each case and returns a register value.

name: scale_word_with_fixed_base
description: Clears a status byte and stores a 32-bit value equal to a stored 16-bit value multiplied by an input word, plus a fixed base constant.

name: select_case_by_second_code
description: Returns at once when a status byte is set. Otherwise it selects a case from a second stored code of 0, 1, 2, 4 or 8, updates a related code, calls routines in each case and returns a register value. It mirrors its sibling with the comparisons reversed.

name: store_scaled_word_with_base
description: Stores into a second 32-bit field a stored 16-bit value multiplied by an input word, plus a fixed base constant.

name: check_value_band_and_flag
description: Clears two status bytes, then sets one when a routine's value falls outside the band 15 to 29. Inside that band it sets the status byte only when a second routine's value is below 5.

name: composite_masked_shifted_rows
description: Combines four source words per cell into four bitplane rows, shifting them by the low four bits of an input. It first clears the bits covered by the inverted OR of the source words, then ORs in the shifted bits, working row by row over a rectangle.

name: composite_masked_shifted_longs
description: Does the same masked, shifted combine as its sibling but works on 32-bit groups of two words per plane. It clears and ORs bits into the four-plane rectangle in the same row order.

name: copy_shifted_rows_to_planes
description: Clears the first word of four plane rows, then for each row ORs a bit-shifted copy of four source words into the four bitplanes. The shift comes from the low four bits of an input.

name: write_shifted_source_columns
description: Repeatedly ORs bit-shifted source words into four plane positions, moving down each column. At the end of each column it clears four destination words, and it stops after the column count is used up.

name: copy_plane_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a block of four-plane words from the screen buffer into a separate buffer, one word per plane per cell, advancing across rows until the block is done.

name: restore_plane_block_from_buffer
description: Copies a block of four-plane words back from a separate buffer into the screen buffer, reversing the direction of its sibling routine.

name: program_blitter_and_wait
description: Sets the hardware blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers, enables DMA, and waits for the blitter to finish. It calls the wait routine in between operations.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: set_bit_in_byte_table
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of a data register, in the byte just before an address register, then calls a routine.

name: set_bit_in_byte_table
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of a data register, in the byte just before an address register, then calls a routine. It is identical to its sibling routine.

name: set_bit_in_byte_table
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of a data register, in the byte just before an address register, then calls a routine.

name: set_bit_in_byte_table
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of a data register, in the byte just before an address register, then calls a routine. It is identical to its sibling routines.

name: set_bit_in_byte_table
description: Sets one bit, chosen by the low three bits of a data register, in the byte just before an address register, then calls a routine. It is identical to its sibling routines.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: forward_to_routine_unchanged
description: Calls one routine and returns, with no status writes or branches. It only passes control onward.

name: clear_matching_bit_rows
description: Walks blocks of eight bytes and, bit by bit, clears a bit in byte 6 or byte 7 of each block when the bits across the other bytes of that block match a fixed pattern. It returns once the block count is used up.

name: pull_value_toward_target
description: When a 16-bit value is nonzero and not equal to 108, it moves the value toward 108 by a fraction of the distance. The fraction comes from a second word offset from 24 by 34, and the product is shifted right by 6 bits.

name: load_picture_set_sequence
description: Sets a 32-bit value to a series of fixed constants, calling a routine for each, and toggles a flag around the first call. The referenced text names five picture files on the disk, so the routine appears to load picture data, though the constants themselves are not explained by the code.

name: copy_long_block
description: Copies 8000 32-bit values from a source block to a destination block with a simple loop.

name: call_eight_routines_in_order
description: Calls eight routines one after the other and returns. It has no branches or stored values.

name: set_pair_246_73_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 246 and 73 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_262_74_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 262 and 74 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_277_74_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 277 and 74 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_295_75_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 295 and 75 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_246_170_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 246 and 170 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_262_171_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 262 and 171 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_277_171_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 277 and 171 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: set_pair_295_172_call
description: Writes the fixed 16-bit values 295 and 172 into a pair of stored words, calls a routine and returns.

name: call_three_times_restoring_word
description: Saves a 16-bit word, calls a routine, restores the word, and calls a routine again with the data register passed in. It restores the word once more and makes a final call.

name: refresh_pairs_on_countdown_zero
description: Decrements a countdown word and returns until it reaches zero, then reloads it with 20 and sets a second counter to 10. For each of four flag bits that is set, it writes a fixed pair of 16-bit values and calls a routine.

name: tick_countdown_and_reload
description: Decrements a countdown byte and returns while it is not zero. When it reaches zero it reloads the countdown with 20, sets a second counter to 10 and calls a routine.

name: refresh_pairs_on_countdown_second
description: Decrements a second countdown byte and returns while it is not zero. When it reaches zero it reloads the countdown with 20, sets another counter to 10, and for each of four flag bits that is set it writes a fixed pair of 16-bit values and calls a routine.

name: tick_second_countdown_and_reload
description: Decrements the second countdown byte and returns while it is not zero. When it reaches zero it reloads that byte with 20, sets the first countdown to 10 and calls a routine.

name: call_indexed_pairs_by_flags
description: For each of four flag bits that is set, it writes a fixed pair of 16-bit values, calls a routine with an index from 0 to 3 and the first value, and restores the stored words. A final call to a routine follows the last pair.

name: save_pair_call_and_restore
description: Saves a 16-bit pair, calls a routine, restores the pair, and then calls a routine twice more before returning.

name: call_second_pairs_by_flags
description: For each of four flag bits that is set, it writes a fixed pair of 16-bit values, calls a routine with an index from 0 to 3 and the first value, and restores the stored words. It uses a different set of fixed values from its neighbour.

name: save_pair_call_and_restore
description: Saves a 16-bit pair, calls a routine, restores the pair, and then calls a routine twice more before returning. It is identical to its sibling routine.

name: configure_entry_with_constant_a
description: Sets a 32-bit constant, computes a 32-bit value from an input word times 64 plus a fixed base, sets a mode value of 8 and a second value of 1, then calls a routine.

name: configure_entry_with_constant_b
description: Sets a different 32-bit constant, computes a 32-bit value from an input word times 64 plus a fixed base, sets a mode value of 8 and a second value of 1, then calls a routine.

name: configure_entry_with_constant_c
description: Sets a third 32-bit constant, computes a 32-bit value from an input word times 64 plus a fixed base, sets a mode value of 8 and a second value of 1, then calls a routine.

name: wait_for_blitter_repeatedly
description: Calls the blitter wait routine four times in a row and then once more before returning. The wait routine polls the blitter-busy bit until the blitter is idle.

name: clear_four_state_values
description: Writes zero into four stored state values and returns.

name: clear_four_state_values
description: Writes zero into four stored state values and returns. It is identical to its sibling routine.

name: build_text_entry_table
description: Clears a table of 212 sixteen-byte entries and fills each with a fixed pattern. It then scans a character buffer for codes and copies the byte that follows each match into the entries, and a final pass fills one column with rotating values and adjusts entries that hold a fixed character.

name: build_text_entry_table
description: Repeats the same clear, scan and fill sequence as its sibling routine, building a table of 212 sixteen-byte entries from a character buffer.

name: build_text_entry_table
description: Repeats the same clear, scan and fill sequence as its sibling routines, building a table of 212 sixteen-byte entries from a character buffer. The referenced text is a run of repeated characters.

name: wait_entry_set_flag_8
description: Calls a routine and checks a table entry chosen by a state byte, repeating until the entry meets a set of conditions. It then sets flag bit 8 in that entry's status byte.

name: wait_entry_set_flag_16
description: Calls a routine and checks a table entry chosen by a state byte, repeating until the entry meets a set of conditions. It then sets flag bit 16 in that entry's status byte.

name: wait_entry_set_flag_32

name: wait_entry_set_flag_64
